env.scratch: SCR = a fresh empty dir (this run: the session scratchpad .../scratchpad/p3); D = docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p3-migrate
env.fixture: bun run fixture:legacy-land $SCR/migrate/ud > $SCR/migrate/fixture.json   (seed "legacy-land"; copy kept as fixture-manifest.json)
env.app: OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/migrate/ud bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9350   (empty key values block the repo .env; the app's default provider was apple-fm, shown UNREACHABLE)
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9350 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat $D/run.json)"   (parts B and C: run-b-restart.json on 9350, run-c-pristine-after-fix.json on 9351)
env.close: CDP_PORT=<port> bun $D/close-app.ts.txt   (Browser.close on the browser target; `kill <Electron pid>` if it still listens)
env.window: 1440 x ~850 CSS px, device scale 2, in the background; UI switched to English in each part
env.build: main 51817a3 plus the uncommitted working tree of every session (other sessions edited src/shared/llm.ts, src/main/inference/** and the i18n tables live; Vite hot-reloaded during the run). Parts A and B ran before this session's planner fix; part C ran after it.

model: none (no [inference] line in parts A, B or C)
sequence: shell: bun run fixture:legacy-land $SCR/migrate/ud; hash every fixture file (before.sha256, 45 files)
run.json (part A): title, English, Worlds → Saves, Resume (migrates), walk to the oversized chunk 1,1, leave Play, Continue, call world.ensure again
shell: close the app; re-hash the 45 fixture files; bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json $D/digest.ts.txt $SCR/migrate/ud 23qc-6pqs-mucdvy80
run-b-restart.json (part B): English, Continue after the restart, read what ensure did, talk to the resident on the legacy-only chunk, leave Play

shell: close; bun run fixture:legacy-land $SCR/pristine; cp -Rp $SCR/pristine $SCR/migrate2/ud; cp -Rp $SCR/migrate/ud/identity $SCR/migrate2/ud/ (same device key); write inference.json (llamacpp at a dead 127.0.0.1:8859)
run-c-pristine-after-fix.json (part C): same display name (player-CP8P), Continue; then cmp the first 21 log lines with part A's

actions.note: A2: UI language English (the system default is zh-TW)
A3: Worlds → Saves: the fixture save, no history yet
A4: Resume runs world.ensure, which migrates

actions.eval: (async () => { const p = (await import("/engine/playerProbe.ts")).samplePlayer(); const s = (await import("/state/index.ts")); const l = s.useLandStore.getState(); return { p, marks: l.marks, keys: Object.keys(l.chunks ?? {}) }; })()

actions.note: A5: walk to the oversized chunk 1,1 (legacyOnly)
A6: leave Play and come back (same session)

actions.eval: (async () => { const s = await import("/state/index.ts"); const h = s.useHistoryStore.getState(); const w = h.world; return w.status === "ready" ? { head: w.value.sequenced.head, ensured: { migrated: w.value.ensured?.migrated, added: w.value.ensured?.added, skipped: w.value.ensured?.skipped?.length } } : w.status })()

actions.note: A7: the rerun: world.ensure again, directly

actions.eval: (async () => { const r = await window.seed.world.ensure("23qc-6pqs-mucdvy80", "player-CP8P"); return r.ok ? { worldId: r.value.worldId, migrated: r.value.migrated, added: r.value.added, adoptedFrom: r.value.adoptedFrom, skipped: r.value.skipped.map(s => s.what + " " + s.key + " " + s.code), adjusted: r.value.adjusted, head: r.value.status.head } : r.error })()
